guards: Existing exact ELF build ID and launcher full-file hashes; pinned-input.h and pinned-button-size.h verify four additional display-list/sizing prologues before any detour activates.

appearance.evidence: Pinned DoDrawWidgetBackground jump table at 0x12bc2dc sends entries 10 and 31 to the PaintButton branch at 0x6a5fdc8; initial guessed enum values failed the native image test and were rejected.

label.ownership: Initialize an empty substring, call the engine accessor, encode its UTF16, then release through the real engine Finalize. No localization or whitespace algorithm copied.
label.default_title_evidence: Matching omni.ja res/locale/layout/HtmlForm.properties and chrome/en-US/locale/en-US/global/layout/HtmlForm.properties contain Submit Query and Reset. Only test references include these strings.

display_list.ownership: Within this exact input-button frame, suppress only the text frame whose content is its anonymous label node, and only after caching the complete actual NSButton snapshot. All other block/text frames retain their original builders.

interfaces.geometry_input_lifetime: Reuse input-source-audit.json frame rectangle union, trusted click, focus traversal, native responder input and frame/cache/process ownership interfaces; no new control implementation.

sizing.native_metric: Existing NXSResponse.parts[1] from nxs_control_size, supplied by actual NSButtonCell cellSize; outward pixel rounding followed by app-unit conversion.

intrinsic.return_value: nscoord content inline size; native cell width minus engine-provided border/padding

offsets.abi: 12-byte padding/border/margin ints in x0 and w1

auto.abi: 8-byte LogicalSize in x0, inline size low 32 bits, block size high 32 bits

sizing.ownership: Retain the original auto inline/shrink-to-fit calculation and full nsIFrame::ComputeSize constraint pipeline. Substitute native intrinsic width and automatic block size, using the supplied engine border/padding. No native font measurement, content insets or CSS constraint solver copied.
sizing.first_reflow: Bind the semantic button model with a minimal measurement viewport before first reflow; keep input ownership disabled until a complete native snapshot at the live frame size is prepared. Mouse/key entry prepares that snapshot even before first paint.
sizing.writing_mode: Pinned frame writing mode byte at 108, vertical bit 1; native sizing currently horizontal scale 1 only.

qualification: Horizontal scale 1; fixed and native auto sizes, value/default/Unicode/empty titles, native font metrics, basic flex/grid and min/max-content, explicit CSS min/max. HTML button rich content, default-button policy, vertical/scaled output and full browser interfaces remain open.
